mentions.name: TailStats
mentions.description: This app displays data on almost any device (iOS, Android, macOS), avoiding the need to build dashboards or single-purpose mini apps. It also works with AI agents via an API and MCP so agents can create interactive cards.
mentions.problem: Built so the author doesn't have to build dashboards or mini one-purpose apps that clog the menu bar and workspace.
